subject: Billy Sharp, 40, comes out of retirement for Rushden & Diamonds in the FA Cup
title: Billy Sharp's three-week retirement

lines.vo: Billy Sharp retired in October. He was back by November.
He is forty, and he has signed for AFC Rushden and Diamonds. Yes, really.
lines.footage: Rushden and Diamonds club crest, Sharp archive

lines.vo: James Clifton is suspended, so Sharp covers, against Burton Albion in the FA Cup.
lines.footage: Rushden Diamonds Burton Albion FA Cup

lines.vo: His last game before retiring? A hat-trick against Peterborough. Hat-trick, goodbye, comeback.
Even boy bands wait longer than three weeks.
lines.footage: Billy Sharp best goals Sheffield United

lines.vo: He has two hundred and ninety-nine career goals. One more is a nice round number. Just saying.
lines.footage: Billy Sharp best goals Sheffield United

lines.vo: Chris Wilder says he still keeps himself very fit. Retirement was clearly just a rest day.
lines.footage: Chris Wilder press clip, Sharp training

inserts.story: Setup: a grumpy cartoon scientist hangs a 'Retired' sign on his lab door and pours one tiny coffee. Gag: the sign has not dried when a phone rings with a cover request. Twist: he answers mid-sip, already wearing boots under his lab coat.
inserts.characters: grumpy lab-coat scientist caricature of Billy Sharp; teenage sidekick with a clipboard

inserts.story: Setup: the sidekick reads out the goal tally from a clipboard. Gag: the paper runs out at two hundred and ninety-nine. Twist: the scientist hands over one sticky note that says 'Room for one more.'
inserts.characters: same scientist caricature; cartoon lab assistant

inserts.story: Setup: a retirement party is still running, balloons sagging, banner reading 'Retired'. Gag: the scientist does push-ups on the buffet table. Twist: the sidekick quietly flips the banner to 'Back in a minute'.
inserts.characters: scientist caricature; cartoon party guests in paper hats
